requirement.description: Delay and Tick classes do not support method chaining, causing TypeError in tests that expect chaining like delay(1).delay(1) or tick().sample()
requirement.contract: Delay and Tick classes must support method chaining by implementing proper __getattr__ methods that return self for supported methods like 'delay', 'sample', 'repeat', etc. The classes should also properly implement the expected interface for simulator triggers.

requirement.description: PosEdgeTrigger and related trigger classes lack required attributes like 'negedge' and 'delay' causing AttributeError
requirement.contract: PosEdgeTrigger, NegEdgeTrigger, and ChangedTrigger classes must implement proper attributes and methods to support simulator trigger operations. Specifically, PosEdgeTrigger should have a 'negedge' property and 'delay' method.

requirement.description: Context class methods like posedge, negedge, changed, and tick do not properly handle simulator triggers, causing TypeError or AttributeError
requirement.contract: Context class methods should return proper trigger objects that support expected simulator operations. The posedge/negedge/changed methods should return trigger objects with proper async iteration support, and tick should return a Tick object that supports chaining.

requirement.description: Local test functions in test files have incorrect signatures causing TypeError when called by concurrent execution
requirement.contract: Functions passed to concurrent execution must accept the correct number of parameters. Local functions in test methods like perform_test_crc_bytes, perform_test_crc_words, perform_test_crc_match should accept a 'name' parameter to match the expected call signature.

requirement.description: Local test functions in test files have incorrect signatures causing TypeError when called by concurrent execution
requirement.contract: Functions passed to concurrent execution must accept the correct number of parameters. Local functions in test methods like test_basic should accept a parameter to match the expected call signature.
